ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Bottler_User', ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c , 'US'), OR( AND( BEGINS(OwnerId,'00G'), CONTAINS(LEFT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 4), 'CCNA'), NOT( OR( CONTAINS(RIGHT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, 2), 'BC'), Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_FOS_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Specialists_Queue', Owner:Queue.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_CIC_Bottler_Queue' ) ) ), AND( BEGINS(OwnerId,'005'), ISPICKVAL( Owner:User.Country_Code__c , 'US'), NOT( OR(Owner:User.Id = $User.Id, Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'CCNA_Frontline_Agent') ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are only allowed to assign the case to CCNA FOS Queue,CCNA CIC Bottler Queue or CCNA Specialists Queue or Bottling Company Queue or CCNA Frontline Agent
